fields.name: careers_hero_tagline
fields.instructions: Intro text displayed above the title.
fields.default_value: Join us on our journey to solve the most exciting technological challenges and shape the future through innovation

fields.label: Team Section Title
fields.name: careers_team_title
fields.instructions: Section #team heading.

fields.label: Team Tagline
fields.name: careers_team_tagline
fields.instructions: Left-column tagline paragraph.
fields.default_value: Our team brings together exceptional developers, engineers, technologists, and constructors — all inspired by the technological challenges we tackle. There is also a great deal of analytical and creative work in what we do, so we've gathered designers, marketers, and analysts who are genuinely excited by the chip making process.

fields.label: Team Text
fields.name: careers_team_text
fields.instructions: Right-column text. Supports multiple paragraphs separated by newlines.
fields.default_value:
We welcome people from all backgrounds. What matters most is sharing our passion for progress and our aspirations for the future of the industry. And we believe the best ideas emerge when curious minds come together — so we support continuous learning, encourage bold thinking, and grow as one team.

Ready to make an impact? Check out our open roles and join the team.
